jp: 毎朝[まいあさ]早[はや]く起[お]きれ{ば|ba-conditional}、散歩[さんぽ]{を|o-object}する時間[じかん]{が|ga-existence}あります。
en: If you get up early every morning, you have time for a walk.
why: A condition whose result follows from it takes ば on the e-stem: 起きれ + ば.

jp: 安[やす]けれ{ば|ba-conditional}、この靴[くつ]{を|o-object}買[か]います。
en: If it's cheap, I'll buy these shoes.
why: An i-adjective forms its conditional by changing い to けれ + ば: 安けれ + ば.

jp: 天気[てんき]{が|ga-subject}よけれ{ば|ba-conditional}、公園[こうえん]{で|de-place}お弁当[べんとう]{を|o-object}食[た]べましょう。
en: If the weather is good, let's eat our lunch boxes in the park.
why: After the adjective stem よけれ, only ば makes the 'if' clause; the others cannot attach.

jp: 時間[じかん]{が|ga-existence}あれ{ば|ba-conditional}、手伝[てつだ]います。
en: If I have time, I'll help.
why: The conditional of ある is あれば; the stem あれ takes ば and nothing else here.

jp: 質問[しつもん]{が|ga-existence}なけれ{ば|ba-conditional}、終[お]わります。
en: If there are no questions, we'll finish.
why: The negative stem なけれ is completed by ば to mean 'if there is not'.

jp: 明日[あした]雨[あめ]{が|ga-subject}降[ふ]らなけれ{ば|ba-conditional}、公園[こうえん]{で|de-place}試合[しあい]{が|ga-existence}あります。
en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, there will be a match in the park.
why: A negative condition is 〜なければ: the stem なけれ requires ば.

jp: 薬[くすり]{を|o-object}飲[の]め{ば|ba-conditional}、すぐ治[なお]ります。
en: If you take the medicine, you'll get better soon.
why: A godan verb forms ば on its e-stem (飲め), and the clause then leads to its result.

jp: 毎日[まいにち]走[はし]れ{ば|ba-conditional}、体[からだ]{が|ga-subject}強[つよ]くなります。
en: If you run every day, your body gets stronger.
why: 走る is a godan verb, so its conditional is the e-stem 走れ + ば.

jp: 駅[えき]{から|kara-from}歩[ある]け{ば|ba-conditional}、十分[じゅっぷん]かかります。
en: If you walk from the station, it takes ten minutes.
why: The e-stem 歩け needs ば to say 'if you walk'; the other particles do not attach to it.

jp: 窓[まど]{を|o-object}開[あ]けれ{ば|ba-conditional}、涼[すず]しい風[かぜ]{が|ga-subject}入[はい]ります。
en: If you open the window, a cool breeze comes in.
why: Ichidan verbs drop る and add れ: 開ける becomes 開けれ + ば.

jp: 急[いそ]げ{ば|ba-conditional}、まだ間[ま]に合[あ]います。
en: If we hurry, we can still make it.
why: 急ぐ becomes 急げ + ば for 'if we hurry'; ば is the only particle that fits the e-stem.

jp: ゆっくり考[かんが]えれ{ば|ba-conditional}、この問題[もんだい]{が/は|ga-stative}分[わ]かります{よ|yo-assertion}。
en: If you think about it slowly, you'll understand this problem.
why: 考える gives the ば form 考えれば, a condition whose result follows from it.

jp: 聞[き]け{ば|ba-conditional}、先生[せんせい]{は/が|wa-topic}教[おし]えてくれます。
en: If you ask, the teacher will tell you.
why: 聞く is godan: 聞け + ば means 'if you ask'.

jp: もっと早[はや]く寝[ね]れ{ば|ba-conditional}よかったです。
en: I should have gone to bed earlier.
why: The regret pattern 〜ばよかった (should have done) is built only with ば on the e-stem.

jp: 昨日[きのう]もっと勉強[べんきょう]しておけ{ば|ba-conditional}よかった。
en: I should have studied more yesterday.
why: Regret about the past uses 〜ばよかった, so ば follows the e-stem おけ.

jp: 分[わ]からないとき{は|wa-topic}、先生[せんせい]{に/から|ni-source}聞[き]け{ば|ba-conditional}いいです{よ|yo-assertion}。
en: When you don't understand, you should just ask the teacher.
why: Advice 〜ばいい (you should just) is formed with ば on the e-stem 聞け.

jp: 寒[さむ]けれ{ば|ba-conditional}、窓[まど]{を|o-object}閉[し]め{ても|te-mo}いいです{よ|yo-assertion}。
en: If you're cold, you may close the window.
why: The adjective stem 寒けれ completes an 'if' clause with ば.

jp: 値段[ねだん]{が|ga-subject}高[たか]けれ{ば|ba-conditional}、買[か]いません。
en: If the price is high, I won't buy it.
why: 高い becomes 高けれ + ば; the other particles cannot follow けれ.

jp: 近[ちか]けれ{ば|ba-conditional}、車[くるま]{は/が|wa-topic}要[い]りません。
en: If it's close, I don't need a car.
why: 近い becomes 近けれ + ば: the adjective's own conditional form.

jp: 忙[いそが]しけれ{ば|ba-conditional}、来[こ]なく{ても|te-mo}いいです{よ|yo-assertion}。
en: If you're busy, you don't have to come.
why: 忙しい turns into 忙しけれ + ば; only ば attaches to the けれ stem.

jp: 部屋[へや]{が|ga-subject}もう少[すこ]し大[おお]きけれ{ば|ba-conditional}、借[か]りたいです。
en: If the room were a little bigger, I'd want to rent it.
why: The adjective 大きい forms its conditional as 大きけれ + ば.

jp: 眠[ねむ]けれ{ば|ba-conditional}、コーヒー{を|o-object}飲[の]みましょう。
en: If you're sleepy, let's have some coffee.
why: 眠い turns into 眠けれ + ば; the other options cannot attach to this stem.

jp: 宿題[しゅくだい]{を|o-object}しなけれ{ば|ba-conditional}、遊[あそ]び{に|ni-purpose}行[い]けません。
en: If you don't do your homework, you can't go out to play.
why: The negative conditional is 〜なければ; the stem なけれ takes ば.

jp: 早[はや]く出[で]なけれ{ば|ba-conditional}、遅[おく]れます。
en: If we don't leave early, we'll be late.
why: 出ない becomes 出なけれ + ば for the negative condition 'if we don't leave'.

jp: ご飯[はん]{を|o-object}食[た]べなけれ{ば|ba-conditional}、体[からだ]{が|ga-subject}弱[よわ]くなります。
en: If you don't eat, your body gets weak.
why: A negative condition with a result: 食べなけれ + ば.

jp: 薬[くすり]{を|o-object}飲[の]まなけれ{ば|ba-conditional}、熱[ねつ]{が|ga-subject}下[さ]がりません。
en: If you don't take the medicine, your fever won't go down.
why: 飲まない becomes 飲まなけれ + ば for 'if you don't take'.

jp: 早[はや]く来[く]れ{ば|ba-conditional}、いい席[せき]{に|ni-location}座[すわ]れます。
en: If you come early, you can get a good seat.
why: 来る has the irregular ば form 来れば, with ば attached to 来れ.

jp: 春[はる]{に|ni-change}なれ{ば|ba-conditional}、桜[さくら]{が|ga-subject}咲[さ]きます。
en: When spring comes, the cherry blossoms bloom.
why: なる becomes なれ + ば, a general condition with a natural result.

jp: 運動[うんどう]{を|o-object}すれ{ば|ba-conditional}、元気[げんき]{に|ni-change}なります{よ|yo-assertion}。
en: If you exercise, you'll feel better.
why: する has the irregular ば form すれば, and ば is the only particle that attaches to すれ.

jp: 右[みぎ]{に/へ|ni-destination}曲[ま]がれ{ば|ba-conditional}、郵便局[ゆうびんきょく]{が|ga-sense}見[み]えます。
en: If you turn right, you'll see the post office.
why: 曲がる is godan, so its ば form is 曲がれ + ば.

jp: この道[みち]{を|o-path}まっすぐ行[い]け{ば|ba-conditional}、駅[えき]{に|ni-destination}着[つ]きます。
en: If you go straight along this road, you'll reach the station.
why: The classic direction pattern: e-stem 行け + ば, then the result.

jp: ボタン{を|o-object}押[お]せ{ば|ba-conditional}、ドア{が|ga-subject}開[あ]きます。
en: If you press the button, the door opens.
why: 押す becomes 押せ + ば, a condition leading to a predictable result.

jp: 砂糖[さとう]{を|o-object}入[い]れれ{ば|ba-conditional}、もっと甘[あま]くなります。
en: If you add sugar, it'll get sweeter.
why: Ichidan 入れる drops る and adds れ: 入れれ + ば means 'if you add'.

jp: 二人[ふたり]{で|de-scope}食[た]べれ{ば|ba-conditional}、このケーキ{は|wa-topic}すぐなくなります。
en: If the two of us eat it, this cake will be gone soon.
why: Ichidan 食べる drops る and adds れ: 食べれ + ば.

jp: 地図[ちず]{を|o-object}見[み]れ{ば|ba-conditional}、場所[ばしょ]{が|ga-stative}分[わ]かります。
en: If you look at the map, you'll see where it is.
why: 見る becomes 見れ + ば, 'if you look'.

jp: 毎晩[まいばん]早[はや]く寝[ね]れ{ば|ba-conditional}、朝[あさ]{は|wa-topic}元気[げんき]です。
en: If you go to bed early every night, you feel fine in the morning.
why: 寝る gives 寝れ + ば, a habitual condition with its usual result.

jp: 説明書[せつめいしょ]{を|o-object}読[よ]め{ば|ba-conditional}、すぐ使[つか]えます。
en: If you read the manual, you can use it right away.
why: 読む becomes 読め + ば; the e-stem takes ば to form the condition.

jp: もう少[すこ]し待[ま]て{ば|ba-conditional}、バス{が|ga-subject}来[き]ます。
en: If you wait a little longer, the bus will come.
why: 待つ becomes 待て + ば, 'if you wait'.

jp: 少[すこ]し休[やす]め{ば|ba-conditional}、すぐ元気[げんき]{に|ni-change}なります{よ|yo-assertion}。
en: If you rest a little, you'll soon feel better.
why: 休む becomes 休め + ば: a condition followed by its natural result.

jp: 雨[あめ]{が|ga-subject}降[ふ]れ{ば|ba-conditional}、試合[しあい]{は|wa-topic}中止[ちゅうし]です。
en: If it rains, the match is cancelled.
why: 降る becomes 降れ + ば; the cancellation follows directly from the condition.

jp: 手紙[てがみ]{を|o-object}書[か]け{ば|ba-conditional}、母[はは]{が/は|ga-subject}喜[よろこ]びます。
en: If you write a letter, my mother will be pleased.
why: 書く becomes 書け + ば for 'if you write'.

jp: もし問題[もんだい]{が|ga-existence}あれ{ば|ba-conditional}、すぐ電話[でんわ]します。
en: If there is any problem, I'll call right away.
why: ある becomes あれ + ば, the usual way to say 'if there is'.

jp: もう少[すこ]し早[はや]く家[いえ]{を|o-departure}出[で]れ{ば|ba-conditional}、電車[でんしゃ]{で|de-place}座[すわ]れます{よ|yo-assertion}。
en: If you leave home a little earlier, you can sit on the train.
why: 出る becomes 出れ + ば, 'if you leave'.

jp: 説明[せつめい]{を|o-object}聞[き]け{ば|ba-conditional}、誰[だれ]{でも|demo-any}できます。
en: If you listen to the explanation, anyone can do it.
why: 聞く becomes 聞け + ば: listening is the condition, being able to do it the result.

jp: 辞書[じしょ]{を|o-object}使[つか]え{ば|ba-conditional}、この言葉[ことば]{の|no-possessive}意味[いみ]{が|ga-subject}分[わ]かります。
en: If you use a dictionary, you'll understand the meaning of this word.
why: 使う becomes 使え + ば for 'if you use'.

jp: 夕方[ゆうがた]{まで|made-until}待[ま]て{ば|ba-conditional}、少[すこ]し涼[すず]しくなります。
en: If you wait until evening, it will get a little cooler.
why: 待つ becomes 待て + ば: a general condition with its natural result.

jp: 友達[ともだち]{と|to-with}話[はな]せ{ば|ba-conditional}、少[すこ]し元気[げんき]{に|ni-change}なります{よ|yo-assertion}。
en: If you talk with a friend, you'll feel a little better.
why: 話す becomes 話せ + ば for 'if you talk'.

jp: 本屋[ほんや]{で|de-place}探[さが]せ{ば|ba-conditional}、その本[ほん]{が|ga-subject}見[み]つかります。
en: If you look in the bookstore, you'll find that book.
why: 探す becomes 探せ + ば: searching is the condition, finding the result.

jp: 窓[まど]{を|o-object}閉[し]めれ{ば|ba-conditional}、外[そと]{の|no-possessive}音[おと]{は/が|wa-topic}聞[き]こえません。
en: If you close the window, you can't hear the noise outside.
why: 閉める becomes 閉めれ + ば; ば is the only particle that fits this stem.

jp: ここ{に|ni-location}座[すわ]れ{ば|ba-conditional}、海[うみ]{が|ga-sense}よく見[み]えます。
en: If you sit here, you can see the sea well.
why: 座る becomes 座れ + ば for 'if you sit'.

jp: その店[みせ]{に|ni-target}電話[でんわ]{を|o-object}すれ{ば|ba-conditional}、予約[よやく]{が|ga-stative}できます。
en: If you call that shop, you can make a reservation.
why: 電話をする becomes 電話をすれ + ば; する has the irregular stem すれ.

jp: この辺[へん]{は|wa-topic}、冬[ふゆ]{に|ni-change}なれ{ば|ba-conditional}、雪[ゆき]{が|ga-subject}たくさん降[ふ]ります。
en: In this area, when winter comes, it snows a lot.
why: 冬になる becomes 冬になれ + ば, a general condition with its usual result.

jp: この服[ふく]{は|wa-topic}洗[あら]え{ば|ba-conditional}、きれい{に|ni-change}なります。
en: If you wash these clothes, they'll become clean.
why: 洗う becomes 洗え + ば: washing is the condition, becoming clean the result.

jp: 味[あじ]{が|ga-subject}薄[うす]けれ{ば|ba-conditional}、塩[しお]{を|o-object}入[い]れます。
en: If it tastes bland, I'll add some salt.
why: 薄い becomes 薄けれ + ば for 'if it is weak'.

jp: 来週[らいしゅう]{は|wa-topic}仕事[しごと]{が|ga-existence}なけれ{ば|ba-conditional}、旅行[りょこう]{に|ni-purpose}行[い]きます。
en: If I have no work next week, I'll go on a trip.
why: The negative of ある is なけれ + ば, giving 'if there is no work'.

jp: 難[むずか]しけれ{ば|ba-conditional}、先生[せんせい]{に|ni-source}聞[き]きます。
en: If it's difficult, I'll ask the teacher.
why: 難しい becomes 難しけれ + ば; the adjective stem takes ば.
